message.content: {"passages":[{"reference":"6.4","verdict":"revise","checks":{"complete_coverage":true,"no_added_claims":true,"names_and_negations":true,"lexical_fidelity":true,"uncertainties_disclosed":false},"findings":[{"source_quote":"ὡς εἰς γονιμώτατον συλληφθὲν ποιεῖν κριτικὴν σύστασιν","english_quote":"and, gathered together into a supremely fertile state, it formed a structure capable of differentiation.","issue":"The note discusses gathering/conception and differentiation/discernment, but not the force of ὡς εἰς.
